Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

A prefill cancellation can release source KV after the GPU forward ends while an asynchronous transfer still reads it. Transfer failure state is not itself a source-quiescence acknowledgement.

Four unmodified runs released pages while an asynchronous transfer was still reading them; two also reallocated a page before the source read completed. A matched source-retention control completed normally. All expected client completions, sentinels and health checks passed; client-visible disclosure or overwrite was not established.

## Modifications

Keep a failed sender in `Transferring` while its outstanding count is positive, and avoid caching terminal failure immediately in `abort`. Move affected chunked/waiting prefill aborts to the existing inflight queue so its normal terminal cleanup can release their KV after the source drains. A drained failed room does not wait for the success-only zero-entry cleanup rule.

The fix uses the existing worker-outstanding boundary: a failed room remains nonterminal until every dequeued staging worker has left the transfer call and decremented that count. Aborts then reuse the established inflight-queue cleanup instead of adding a blocking scheduler wait. This deliberately scopes the change to backends that participate in that existing counter contract.

## Accuracy Tests

The new normal-import regressions exercise both ownership boundaries. A failed sender with one outstanding worker remains `Transferring` with no cached terminal state, then becomes `Failed` only after the count reaches zero. A chunked-prefill abort with that sender is placed on the inflight queue; the immediate request cleanup and KV release functions are both verified not to run.

The broader sender-lifecycle, prefill-abort, result-polling and chunked-abort suites pass 21 tests and 36 subtests in 12.05 seconds. They cover success/failure polling, PP consensus, late chunk results, retry, retraction and terminal cleanup.

The matched source-retention serving control at the same release boundary completed all 20 submissions, six disconnect/replacement cycles, the tenant sentinel and the health check with zero lifetime reports.
This patch changes cancellation cleanup only and does not alter logits or sampling.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The normal terminal-success sender poll was timed for nine rounds of 500,000 calls.

-  The baseline measured a 0.289 microsecond median per poll (0.286-0.293 microseconds).
-  The patched branch measured 0.306 microseconds (0.298-0.307 microseconds).
    - added 0.017 microseconds per uncached terminal poll.

The scheduler adds one extra poll only on an abort.
Ordinary request scheduling, forward execution and transfer payloads are unchanged.
The source is retained longer only when a failed transfer still has an outstanding worker, which is the required behavior for correctness.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -2357,10 +2357,11 @@ def _poll_with_status(self, check_status) -> KVPoll:
         # Hold Success until all staging chunks transferred. With deferred
         # allocation also wait for worker cleanup (the zero entry is only
         # removed after cleanup), before permitting the room to be reused.
-        if status == KVPoll.Success and (
+        if status in (KVPoll.Success, KVPoll.Failed) and (
             self.kv_mgr._staging_outstanding.get(self.bootstrap_room, 0) > 0
             or (
-                self.kv_mgr.defer_decode_allocation
+                status == KVPoll.Success
+                and self.kv_mgr.defer_decode_allocation
                 and self.bootstrap_room in self.kv_mgr._staging_outstanding
             )
         ):
@@ -2463,7 +2464,7 @@ def abort(self):
             "Aborted by AbortReq.",
         )
         self.kv_mgr.update_status(self.bootstrap_room, KVPoll.Failed)
-        self.conclude_state = KVPoll.Failed
+        self.conclude_state = None
         self.trace_ctx.abort(abort_info={"reason": "Aborted"})
         self.trace_ctx.trace_req_finish()

@@ -602,6 +602,9 @@ def release_aborted_prefill_waiting_req(self: Scheduler, req: Req) -> None:
         sender = getattr(req, "disagg_kv_sender", None)
         if sender is not None and hasattr(sender, "abort"):
             sender.abort()
+            if sender.poll() == KVPoll.Transferring:
+                self.disagg_prefill_inflight_queue.append(req)
+                return
         maybe_release_metadata_buffer(req, self.req_to_metadata_buffer_idx_allocator)
         if req.kv.holds_kv or req.kv.holds_mamba:
             release_kv_cache(req, self.tree_cache, checkpoint=False)

 from sglang.srt.debug_utils.pr_fix_toggle import maybe_revert_pr_fix
 from sglang.srt.disaggregation import role_switch

 from sglang.srt.disaggregation.checksum import KvChecksumComputer
 from sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode import (
     DecodePreallocQueue,
@@ -3887,12 +3888,18 @@ def process_pending_chunked_abort(self) -> None:
         if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
             self.clear_pending_chunk_send(req)
             req.disagg_kv_sender.abort()
-            maybe_release_metadata_buffer(
-                req, self.req_to_metadata_buffer_idx_allocator
-            )
-            req.pending_bootstrap = False
-        self._release_aborted_request(req)

+            if req.disagg_kv_sender.poll() == KVPoll.Transferring:
+                self.disagg_prefill_inflight_queue.append(req)
+            else:
+                maybe_release_metadata_buffer(
+                    req, self.req_to_metadata_buffer_idx_allocator
+                )
+                req.pending_bootstrap = False
+                self._release_aborted_request(req)

+        else:
+            self._release_aborted_request(req)
+            release_kv_cache(req, self.tree_cache, checkpoint=False)
 
         self.chunked_req = None
         self._pending_chunked_abort_req = None

+import queue
+import unittest
+from collections import deque
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.base import KVPoll  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn import CommonKVSender  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn import MooncakeKVManager  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import (  # noqa: E402
+    get_context,
+    publish,
+    reset_context,
+)
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs  # noqa: E402
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _sender(room=42):
+    manager = object.__new__(MooncakeKVManager)
+    manager.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+    manager.request_status = {}
+    manager.transfer_infos = {room: {"127.0.0.1:1234": SimpleNamespace(dst_port=1234)}}
+    manager.is_dummy_cp_rank = False
+    manager.enable_all_cp_ranks_for_transfer = False
+    manager.attn_cp_size = 1
+    manager.attn_cp_rank = 0
+    manager.enable_staging = False
+    manager._staging_outstanding = {}
+    manager._deferred_ack_targets = {}
+    manager._deferred_ack_poisoned_rooms = set()
+    manager._num_shards = 1
+    manager.transfer_queues = [queue.Queue()]
+    manager._transfer_queues = manager.transfer_queues
+    with get_context().override_server_args(dp_size=1, enable_trace=False):
+        sender = CommonKVSender(manager, "unused", room)
+    return sender, manager
+
+
+class _Req:
+    def __init__(self, rid):
+        self.rid = rid
+        self.kv = SimpleNamespace(holds_kv=True, holds_mamba=False)
+        self.to_finish = None
+        self._finished = False
+        self.discard_output_reason = None
+        self.return_logprob = False
+        self.output_ids = []
+        self.weight_version_events = []
+        self.time_stats = Mock()
+
+    def finished(self):
+        return self._finished
+
+
+def _scheduler(req):
+    scheduler = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
+    scheduler.enable_continuous_input_polling = False
+    scheduler.result_queue = deque()
+    scheduler.chunked_req = req
+    scheduler._pending_chunked_abort_req = req
+    scheduler.waiting_queue = []
+    scheduler.dllm_config = None
+    scheduler.grammar_manager = Mock()
+    scheduler.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+    scheduler.enable_hicache_storage = False
+    scheduler.mm_receiver = None
+    scheduler.rust_server = None
+    scheduler.running_batch = SimpleNamespace(reqs=[])
+    scheduler.last_batch = None
+    scheduler.disagg_prefill_inflight_queue = []
+    scheduler.clear_pending_chunk_send = Mock()
+    scheduler._release_aborted_request = Mock()
+    scheduler.tree_cache = None
+    scheduler.ipc_channels = Mock()
+    return scheduler
+
+
+class TestPrefillSourceRetirement(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        reset_context()
+        self.addCleanup(reset_context)
+        publish(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"), role="tokenizer")
+
+    def test_failure_waits_for_outstanding_staging_chunk(self):
+        sender, manager = _sender()
+        manager.request_status[42] = KVPoll.Failed
+        manager._staging_outstanding[42] = 1
+        self.assertEqual(sender.poll(), KVPoll.Transferring)
+        self.assertIsNone(sender.conclude_state)
+        manager._staging_outstanding[42] = 0
+        self.assertEqual(sender.poll(), KVPoll.Failed)
+        self.assertEqual(sender.conclude_state, KVPoll.Failed)
+
+    def test_prefill_abort_keeps_source_until_transfer_finishes(self):
+        req = _Req("transfer_in_flight")
+        req.disagg_kv_sender = Mock()
+        req.disagg_kv_sender.poll.return_value = KVPoll.Transferring
+        scheduler = _scheduler(req)
+
+        with patch("sglang.srt.managers.scheduler.release_kv_cache") as release:
+            scheduler.process_pending_chunked_abort()
+
+        req.disagg_kv_sender.abort.assert_called_once_with()
+        self.assertEqual(scheduler.disagg_prefill_inflight_queue, [req])
+        scheduler._release_aborted_request.assert_not_called()
+        release.assert_not_called()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
